shadow-slave.description: Growing up in poverty, Sunny is chosen by the Nightmare Spell and becomes one of the Awakened. Transported into a ruined magical world, he must survive terrible creatures, rival Awakened, and the dangerous side effect of his new shadow powers.
shadow-slave.creator: Guiltythree

a-regressor-s-tale-of-cultivation.description: After falling into a cultivation world with six coworkers, Seo Eun-hyun alone has no spiritual roots or special ability. He lives an ordinary mortal life until death sends him back to the beginning, revealing an endless cycle of regression.
a-regressor-s-tale-of-cultivation.creator: Eomcheongnan

kill-the-sun.description: In a post-apocalyptic world ruled by Specters, an amnesiac boy grows strong enough to pursue life as a Zephyx Extractor, only to discover that a forbidden Specter power already threatens his future.
kill-the-sun.creator: Warmaisach

omniscient-reader-s-viewpoint.description: Kim Dokja is the sole reader to finish a long-running web novel. When its scenarios become reality, his knowledge of the original work becomes his only advantage in changing the ending.
omniscient-reader-s-viewpoint.creator: Singsyong

the-beginning-after-the-end.description: King Grey is reborn as Arthur Leywin in a world of magic and monsters. With the memories of his former life intact, he tries to build a more meaningful future while confronting the dangers surrounding his new family.
the-beginning-after-the-end.creator: TurtleMe

mother-of-learning.description: Zorian Kazinski is a young mage trapped in a month-long time loop. Repeatedly reliving the same events, he uses each reset to improve his magic, investigate the loop, and uncover the conspiracy threatening his world.
mother-of-learning.creator: Domagoj Kurmaic
